::: {#def-gibbs-sampler}
#### Gibbs sampler

The **Gibbs sampler** produces $\vth^{(t+1)}$ from $\vth^{(t)}$
by updating one component at a time:
for $k = 1, \ldots, K$ in turn,
it draws $\theta_k^{(t+1)}$ from the [full conditional distribution](#def-full-conditional) of $\theta_k$,
with each other component set to its most recent value
[@dobson4e, Chapter 13, p. 300].
:::
